ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT ZONING LOT AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 15th day of September, 2008 between THE MILAN ASSOCIATES, L.P., 120 West 23rd Enterprises, Inc., 206 Fifth Avenue, 4"h Floor New York, NY 10010 (the “Buyer"). BACKGROUND WHEREAS, Seller owns fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,in the County of NewYork,City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 118-122 West 23"d Street and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1   x   s  n   n x e      hereinafter referred to as "Seller's Land"; said buildings and improvements hereinafter, the "Seller's Building", and Seller's Land and Seller's Building hereinafter "Seller's Property"); WHEREAS, Buyer owns fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City, County and State of New York, known as and by the street address 124-126 West 23rd Street and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and also known as tax lotBlock 798,Lot 57(said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as "Buyer's Land"; said buildings and improvements hereinafter, the "Buyer's Building", and Buyer's Land and Buyer's Building being hereinafter "Buyer's Property"); WHEREAS,the parties heretobelieve that there exist Development Rights(hereinafter defined) appurtenant to Seller's Land which are in excess of the Development Rights utilized by Seller's Building and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork effective December 15,1961,as amended (the"Zoning Resolution").As used in this Agreement, the term "Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratiofor structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located and (ii) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution which may be authorized to be developed by the City of New York (the "City"); WHEREAS, Buyer desires to purchase a portion of Seller's available Development WHEREAS, the Parties have previously executed a certain Contract of Sale (incorporated herein by reference, and hereinafter, the “Contract of Sale"), pursuant to which, Seller has agreed to sell and Buyer has agreed to purchase a portion of Seller's available Development Rights;
